method.title: How the numbers are computed
method.asking: Asking prices are what sellers and landlords ask in their listings. They are not contract prices or valuations, and the final price of a transaction may differ; that is why contract prices are shown separately.
method.median: We show the median, not the average, so a single extreme listing does not change the picture. The “middle 50%” is the range from the 25th to the 75th percentile.
method.threshold: A number is shown only when there are at least {min} listings, the same minimum the UK Office for National Statistics (ONS) uses for a reliable median. Below that we show the count only.
method.exclusions: Listings without a price or a size, or with a price outside plausible bounds, are left out of the numbers. We still count them and show them, so you know how many listings each number comes from.
method.cadence: The price summary is recomputed every night. The list and count of listings refresh every 15 minutes.
